On the bank of the Gualaca River sat two Indian girls fishing. Just up-stream from them arose the precipitous cliff of one of the buttresses of the lofty mountains. The main stream flowed past in chocolate-colored spate; but, directly beneath them, where they fished, was a quiet eddy. No less quiet was the fishing. No bites jerked their rods in token that the bait was enticing. One of them, Nicoya, yawned, ate a banana, yawned again, and held the skin she was about to cast aside suspended in her hand.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0080", "tag": "p", "text": "“We have been very quiet, Concordia,” she observed to her companion, “and it has won us no fish. There!”", "sha256": "4e1aa3f09bb52508b0c10dd2086a2582f38ec1e8972891a13fe2e7d230f94fc6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1986]", "source_html": "

“We have been very quiet, Concordia,” she observed to her companion, “and it has won us no fish. Now shall I make a noise and a splash. Since they say ‘what goes up must come down,’ why should not something come up after something has gone down? I am going to try. There!”

“If anything comes up I hope it will be big,” Concordia murmured with equal laziness.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0084", "tag": "p", "text": "Nicoya and Concordia giggled.", "sha256": "2f84c3b2f201f1882dc659ad74d44d52b2de1ef5eb25dbeefdbc592fcb233391", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1990]", "source_html": "

Nicoya and Concordia giggled.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0085", "tag": "p", "text": "“Try it again,” Concordia urged.", "sha256": "6ad0e8cd9c62b9213fcf2c1305d2f844fbaede155f055f68c0e7a9f1006e76ef", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1991]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0086", "tag": "p", "text": "“No; you this time. And see what you can bring up.”", "sha256": "112dce6e7f36e252e7495b5c36615c2fc7c38fc6afc73b8e9db429ef097aca51", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1992]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0088", "tag": "p", "text": "Again the two Indian girls giggled; but this time, urge as they would, neither could raise the courage to throw anything into the water.", "sha256": "d54c1611ecb8e46a6d47afff437290df139b6237b82c8191bde4f386b0120492", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1994]", "source_html": "
